The doubling time of sample [EXP-061-R4](/detail?type=sample&entity_id=247) (from experiment [EXP-061](/detail?type=experiment&entity_id=204)) is **4.60 hours**.

### Calculation Method
An exponential model was fitted to the OD600 measurements across the exponential growth phase (hours 0 to 18, spanning 10 data points; measurements at hours 20–24 reached stationary plateau at 0.8 OD):

- **Growth rate ($r$):** 0.150669 per hour ($r^2 = 1.0000$)
- **Formula:** doubling time = ln(2) / $r$
- **Evaluation:** ln(2) / 0.150669 = 4.60046 hours
